meta.title: 方圆脸化妆开智，妆容框架‼️总结篇
meta.title_en: Round-Face Makeup Framework: A Master Summary

scenes.context: 方圆脸化妆开智是在你能面对后置镜头的时候，因为在这个视角下才能真正看清你的脸。
sentences: 后置镜头看清真实的脸。
The rear camera shows your true face.
看清才能领悟化妆框架。
Seeing clearly unlocks the makeup framework.
paraphrase: The rear camera shows your true face.
Seeing clearly unlocks the makeup framework.
scenes.speak: The rear camera shows your true face. Seeing clearly unlocks the makeup framework.

scenes.context: 领悟到眉毛不够长，需要画在外轮廓的中间，并且带一些微微的弧度才能修饰脸型。
sentences: Extend the brow to the outer contour.
A gentle arch flatters the face.
paraphrase: Extend the brow to the outer contour.
A gentle arch flatters the face.
scenes.speak: Extend the brow to the outer contour. A gentle arch flatters the face.

scenes.context: 腮红不应该打在中间，而应该选收缩式腮红去修饰外边缘轮廓，才是真正修饰方圆脸的打法。
scenes.speak: Use a contouring blush. Sculpt the outer edge.

scenes.context: 唇妆颜色重要但模糊边界更重要，深刻的唇线边缘会把视觉重心移到下半张脸、显得脸更宽。
sentences: Blurring the lip line matters more.
paraphrase: Blurring the lip line matters more.
scenes.speak: Blurring the lip line matters more. Harsh lines widen the face.

scenes.context: 眼妆重点不是眼线画多长眼影画多深，而是学会利用修容塑造眼眶骨的骨相感，让眼从2D变3D。
sentences: Use contour to shape the orbital bone.
paraphrase: Use contour to shape the orbital bone.
scenes.speak: Use contour to shape the orbital bone. Take the eye from 2D to 3D.

scenes.context: 眼眶骨应该在眉毛到眼角的范围，用高状修容画出小鱼号，眉尾最长的位置到眼角。
sentences: 眼眶骨在眉到眼角的范围。
It spans from brow to eye corner.
paraphrase: It spans from brow to eye corner.
scenes.speak: It spans from brow to eye corner. Draw a small fish-hook shape.

scenes.context: 卧蚕要画成一个眼影面才立体不生硬，新手选带点粗度的平头刷，先画下至找到卧蚕大小和区域。
sentences: Blend the under-eye into a soft shape.
Beginners should use a flat brush.
paraphrase: Blend the under-eye into a soft shape.
Beginners should use a flat brush.
scenes.speak: Blend the under-eye into a soft shape. Beginners should use a flat brush.

scenes.context: 卧蚕画完用高光修容笔提亮最中间的位置，不要贴到眼下根部，用手指轻轻拍两下晕开。
sentences: Highlight the center with a brightening pen.
Don't go right under the eye.
paraphrase: Highlight the center with a brightening pen.
Don't go right under the eye.
scenes.speak: Highlight the center with a brightening pen. Don't go right under the eye.

practice: 用后置镜头看清真实的自己。
The rear camera shows your true face.
Extend the brow to the outer contour.
pitfalls: 用后置镜头看清真实脸型
画到外轮廓中间带弧度
用收缩式腮红修饰外边缘
硬唇线把视线引到下半脸
